title: Projection indexes task aliases, not only ids (post-0.15.1)
description: From the #756 round-1 verdict (LCLI-809), S3. src/core/projection.ts indexes only task.id in taskKeys, so a tasks: entry or dependency naming an alias projects as dangling: true, while lore orphans now calls it live. Index id plus aliases by referenceKey, with a test red without it. Mind the fold-key collision follow-up: two tasks whose keys collide must not silently share a record key.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A tasks: entry and a dependency naming a task alias project as dangling: false, each with a test red without the change
